auth_details: API key required; register at https://api.data.gov/signup/ and pass it as api_key (or the supported X-Api-Key header).
rate_limits: api.data.gov default: 1,000 requests/hour per API key (agency override possible). DEMO_KEY: 30 req/IP/hour and 50/IP/day. Check X-RateLimit-* response headers for effective limits.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. SI Open Access docs say register for a key via the public API hosted on api.data.gov (https://www.si.edu/openaccess/devtools; https://www.si.edu/openaccess/faq); SI’s own client README points to https://api.data.gov/signup/ (https://github.com/Smithsonian/smithsonian-openaccess). Pass via api_key query param or X-Api-Key (https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/). rate_limits: auditor correct. SI does not publish a separate override; api.data.gov defaults apply: 1,000 req/hour per key; DEMO_KEY 30/IP/hour and 50/IP/day; use X-RateLimit-* headers (https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/).
